data.name: Essi
data.gender_notes: Essi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 's-s-s', meaning 'to help, to support'. In Islamic tradition, Essi is a name for a supporter, helper, and aide. The name Essi carries the meaning “Help, support” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Essi usually hope their child will grow to embody help, support and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a child who is believed to be a blessing from Allah
data.etymology: Essi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help, support.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Essi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إيسي
in_arabic.meaning: اسماء الله الحسنى، إسم من أسماء الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: إيسي هو اسم مشتق من أسماء الله الحسنى، و يعني الرحمة و الرأفة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و رفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تطلق على الذكور و الإناث.

in_urdu.name: ایسی
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کے خوبصورت نام، رحمت و مہربانی کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایسی ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں سے ماخوذ ہے، اور رحمت و مہربانی کے معانی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورت اور اعلیٰ معانی رکھتا ہے، اور لڑکوں اور لڑکیوں دونوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے.

data.cultural_impact: The name Essi holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, reflecting the importance of community and mutual assistance. Essa (the person named Essi) is seen as a supportive and caring individual, someone who extends a helping hand whenever needed. This ideas ties in with the Islamic value of brotherhood, with Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) emphasizing the importance of supporting your fellow Muslims and ensuring their well-being.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Essi represents the qualities of selflessness, generosity, and compassion. By carrying this name, one is reminded of their duty to help others, both materially and spiritually, in matters big and small. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "None of you will believe until you love for your brother what you love for yourself" (Bukhari and Muslim), and Essi embodies this belief, living a life of service and kindness towards others.
